title: provider 출력의 ID와 구조 검증

fields.입력: raw에 존재하지 않는 ID, 중복 CS, disabled SEC, host 미지원 ID, 잘못된 judgment 값, NaN score를 각각 주입한다.
fields.필수추천: 유효 항목을 위조하지 않고 오류 항목·사유를 보존한다.
fields.금지추천 또는 행동: unknown ID 실행; invalid 구조를 성공으로 처리; disabled를 모델 고득점 때문에 되살림.
fields.허용선택: 미등록·구조 오류에는 INVALID로 baseline fallback하고 원시 오류를 보존한다. 알려진 ID의 미설치·미지원은 목적 판단을 지우지 않고 실행 가용성 경계로 처리한다. provider의 중복·추가·누락 응답은 INVALID다. 상위의 서로 다른 유효 집합에서 반복되는 ID를 결합 시 한 번만 유지하는 것과 구분한다.
fields.보류조건: 스키마 또는 inventory membership 검증 실패.
fields.통과기준: 미등록·구조 오류 항목은 유효 선택으로 채택하지 않는다. 등록된 필요 스킬의 비활성·미지원은 needed에 남기되 runnable에는 0개이며 실행을 차단한다. 중복·충돌·숫자 유효성 결과가 결정적이고 이유가 남는다.

requestedCandidate.status: PARENT_REPORTED_LOCAL_ONLY; independent SOURCE verdict and remote publication unconfirmed

resumeConditions: Parent supplies verified final candidate commit/tree, independent SOURCE verdict, fixed remote source and prerequisite-check outcomes; if candidate changes, pin it explicitly and re-read applicable instructions.

Parent supplies common exact Claude model/revision/effort, successful API authentication procedure, supported route/settings and session isolation/permissions consistent with host hooks; do not guess model or disable required attestation.

Parent supplies approved classification/runtime configuration and qualified current-vendor profile or explicitly limits this run to Claude-executed offline mechanics; any unavailable required live observation remains BLOCKED/NOT_RUN.
Parent confirms case cumulative budget and measured accounting/timeout/retry policy. JEV remains prohibited until separately assigned.

ownership.Sol: Environment, frozen input/hash checks, budget ledger, sanitized evidence collection and publication
ownership.ClaudeCode: Actual local host reads, commands, product-boundary verification and observed selection/read/apply/verify work

stepsAfterResume: Verify exact remote candidate commit and tree and read its AGENTS.md and relevant Claude plugin SKILL.md/reference files. Capture a clean immutable product baseline without modifying product sources or generated deployment files.

Prepare an isolated SS27-only test workspace with the unchanged frozen tests at evidence/SS27/ so ../../ imports and output paths resolve. Preserve original public hashes and test bytes. Do not execute c6a8019 or old main as the candidate.

Start the real Claude Code CLI through the parent-provided API authentication and exact common model settings. Keep secrets out of arguments, artifacts, process output and transcripts. Grant only parent-authorized ephemeral test-workspace actions.

Claude reads the frozen criteria and performs the original 8 mock variants through validateClassificationResponse, SkillClassificationService.classify and validateDecision. No real JEV API is needed or authorized for these injected mock responses.

Claude runs the unchanged boundary tests and targeted regressions using scripts/run-tests.mjs; record argv, exit, assertion counts, source/test digests and sanitized stdout/stderr for the exact verified candidate.

Check preserved raw error causes and finite known cost on INVALID fallback, duplicate JSON keys before parse collapse, true NaN before serialization (retain numeric tags), 0.99 score versus disabled/unsupported, not-installed, omitted responses across statuses and host-support supply.

If live selection is in the approved run, observe actual current installed/enabled/host-supported inventory and signed host selection receipts. AGENT is selection authority; classify advice is support. Record selected/read/applied/verified separately. Leave null when unobserved; [] requires actual accepted no-skill evidence. Never fabricate receipts.

Record upper valid-set deduplication only if actually observed; distinguish it from duplicate provider judgments, which must be INVALID. Frozen mechanical results do not establish semantic accuracy because originalPrompt/oracle are null.

Update cumulative cost/tokens/cache/retries/failures after every paid attempt, reconcile unknown consumption, and stop before another call when near the US$2 case soft limit. Do not repeat a failed call automatically or use fallback model routing without parent approval.
Publish only sanitized SS27 reports/evidence/hash lists under a fresh run path on evidence; re-read every file at the fixed remote publication commit and compare byte digests.
futureCommandsNotExecuted: rejects unknown, duplicate and invalid output without creating negative judgments
SS27/30 malformed and incomplete JEV judgments produce INVALID and vendor fallback
SS27/28 rejects (unknown-id|missing-id|nan) responses rather than producing no-skill

sensitivityProof.reason: No product mutation or execution authorized at preparation stage; no paired red/green or independent audit claimed.
